status: source-only direct intrinsic pending-Promise allocation; controls and peer pending; no execution

linked_constructor_selection.meaning: Undefined new_target duplicates the actual context intrinsic Promise prototype, without live global/constructor/species property reads.

ownership.result: One owned actual Promise; no resolving-function allocation. Existing resolving functions and their one-shot latch are unchanged.
ownership.pending_entry: Native current-pending-only policy preserves an existing actual pending reason before allocation or INIT. This explicitly differs from V8 Resolver::New PREPARE_FOR_EXECUTION entry clearing.
ownership.hook: Real INIT hook runs with the actual Promise and undefined parent, even if an outer reaction allocation has a parent link. It may invoke guest code, retain or settle the Promise, or leave an actual exception.
ownership.hook_failure: The new direct API reports actual hook pending after retiring its owned result through the already established first-actual-fatal reducer. Hook-retained values keep their independent entitlements.
ownership.no_allocation_span_tag: Consumers must use the ordinary guest-capable operation boundary across this API; the hook prevents classifying the whole operation as intrinsic-only.

reversal: Replacing the one new C block by its recorded original and removing the one H addition reproduces the complete continuation C/H byte-for-byte.
